verification.note: Checked against the code. The comment at addons/intelligence/app/llm.py:349-355 is about the vision suspect-failure set, and line 356 is `_JSON_OBJECT_FORMAT = {"type": "json_object"}`, which sits between that comment and `_RESPONSE_FORMAT_SUSPECT_FAILURES` at line 358. The comment now reads as if it describes the new constant. A grep for `_JSON_OBJECT_FORMAT` finds it only at line 356 (where it is defined) and line 577 (`json_mode = response_format == _JSON_OBJECT_FORMAT` in `_generate_result`). `generate_json_result` at line 1227 still passes the literal `{"type": "json_object"}`, as do lines 1147, 1959 and 2009. Module scope is not one of the listed touch points. This is a style/scope issue only. The equality check at line 577 behaves the same as a literal would.

specification_compliance: I2/I9: the latch is set at llm.py:608-609 before the response is classified, so the empty-body retry guard at llm.py:1242 (`not self._json_mode_rejected`) blocks a second request after the resend that latched.
